actors.name: QIQCOP Zoo metadata migration
actors.body: System identity recording the metadata adaptation of existing QIQCOP Zoo records. It attributes the identity and classification metadata migration only; it carries no scientific authorship, verification, or admission-review claim.

actors.name: QIQCOP Zoo catalog exporter
actors.body: Records the mechanical projection of maintained catalog edits into the research ledger at export time. Scientific authorship and evidence remain in the authored source and bibliography; editorial authorship is recorded in Git history. This identity asserts no scientific authorship, review, verification, or admission decision.
